name: Spout2 Layout Feed
description: Plays levels in Layout Mode with hitboxes and trajectory on your screen while OBS receives the normal, fully decorated level through Spout2.

enabled.name: Enable Spout2 sender
enabled.description: Sends the normal game picture (menus, levels, shaders, all 2.2 effects) to OBS. The frame is shared GPU-to-GPU when the driver supports it.

capture-cursor.name: Capture cursor
capture-cursor.description: Draws the Windows cursor into the Spout2 feed only.

capture-menus.name: Show mod menus in OBS
capture-menus.description: Includes Mega Hack and other menus drawn in swapBuffers in the Spout2 feed, like the clean-feed mod. With Layout Mode on, the menus are composited on the GPU into both the feed and your screen.

capture-system-overlays.name: Include Steam overlay (experimental)
capture-system-overlays.description: Captures the frame at the OpenGL driver's present, after in-process overlays such as the Steam overlay, RivaTuner and Discord's legacy in-game overlay have drawn, so OBS shows them too. Overlays in their own window (current Discord overlay, NVIDIA app, Xbox Game Bar) cannot be captured. Falls back to normal capture automatically if the driver hook is not reached.

layout-enabled.name: Enable Layout Mode
layout-enabled.description: Redraws the level on your screen without decoration, colors and shaders. The Spout2 feed always shows the normal level. The level itself is never modified, so triggers, shaders and camera effects keep working.

layout-show-animated-decoration.name: Show animated decoration
layout-show-animated-decoration.description: Keeps decoration that GD rotates or animates (decorative saws, gears, ...) on screen even when decoration is hidden. These objects have no hitbox.

layout-recolor-objects.name: Remove object colors
layout-recolor-objects.description: Draws gameplay objects with the fixed colors below instead of their color channels, pulses and HSV.

layout-force-opacity.name: Show invisible objects
layout-force-opacity.description: Shows objects hidden by alpha triggers, fades or the Hide option (toggled-off groups stay hidden), like Layout Mode with alpha triggers removed.

layout-normal-blending.name: Disable additive blending
layout-normal-blending.description: Draws objects on blending color channels with normal blending so they stay visible.

layout-hide-effects.name: Hide pulse effects
layout-hide-effects.description: Hides the expanding circles of orbs, pads, portals and pickups on your screen.

layout-disable-shaders.name: Disable shaders
layout-disable-shaders.description: Skips 2.2 shader triggers (glitch, chromatic, blur, shockwave, ...) on your screen only.

layout-always-show-player.name: Always show player
layout-always-show-player.description: Keeps your icon visible on your screen when Hide Player triggers or fades hide it. OBS still shows the level as designed.

smart-contrast.name: Smart Contrast
smart-contrast.description: Analyzes a locally saved level once and generates three high-visibility color palettes. The analyzer uses no CPU after it finishes.

show-hitboxes.name: Show hitboxes
show-hitboxes.description: Draws object and player hitboxes on your screen. OBS never shows them.

show-trajectory.name: Show trajectory
show-trajectory.description: Predicts where you go when holding and releasing and draws both paths on your screen only.

toggle-hitboxes-keybind.name: Toggle hitboxes
toggle-hitboxes-keybind.description: Toggles the hitbox overlay in a level or editor, including during the death delay and pause.

toggle-trajectory-keybind.name: Toggle trajectory
toggle-trajectory-keybind.description: Toggles the trajectory overlay in a level or editor, including during the death delay and pause.

high-performance-trajectory.name: High-performance trajectory
high-performance-trajectory.description: Reuses prediction snapshots and their container memory between frames. Disable this to use the v1.4.2 allocation path for troubleshooting.

trajectory-tps.name: Trajectory simulation TPS
trajectory-tps.description: 240 is accurate and usually fast enough. Higher values cost more CPU.

debug-logging.name: Debug logging
debug-logging.description: Writes detailed diagnostics to the Geode log: OpenGL driver info, Spout2 share mode, per-level object statistics, OpenGL errors and periodic CPU/GPU timings.

debug-dump-keybind.name: Dump objects on screen
debug-dump-keybind.description: Writes how every kind of object on screen is classified and drawn by Layout Mode to the log. Press it while a missing object should be visible.

debug-gpu-timers.name: Measure GPU time
debug-gpu-timers.description: Uses asynchronous OpenGL timer queries; they never stall the frame.
